projects.title: myMelier
projects.description:
A sommelier in your pocket. Leveraging text detection, users can take a photo of a wine on a menu and myMelier will render a professional sommelier description and rating. These wines will then be saved to a user's profile with the capability to add their own rating. One interesting feature of myMelier is the ability to alert a user when they take a photo of a wine that they have already saved and remind them of their rating. 

Technologies: React Native, Expo, React-Redux, Express, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Google Cloud Vision API, Passport

Github: bit.ly/myMelier
